SiteFooter.tagline: Independent prop firm payout calculators and public rule comparisons.
SiteFooter.financialDisclaimerBody: This site provides mathematical payout calculations and comparisons of publicly available data only. Nothing here constitutes financial, investment, tax or legal advice. All accounts referenced trade simulated capital, and past payout structures do not guarantee future results. Always verify current rules directly with the prop firm before making a purchase or withdrawal decision.
SiteFooter.affiliateDisclosureBody: Some links on this site are affiliate/referral links. We may earn a commission if you sign up through them, at no extra cost to you. This potential compensation does not influence the objectivity of our calculators, comparisons or rankings — every figure is computed from the same public rules for each firm.
SiteFooter.trademarkNoticeBody: All prop firm names, logos and trademarks shown on this site are the property of their respective owners. They are used here for identification and comparison purposes only and do not imply any endorsement, sponsorship or affiliation with this site unless explicitly stated.
